# Cookie Pinuki

> Handmade boutique bakery in Israel. Cookies, krembo, rugelach, and donuts baked to order.

Cookie Pinuki is an artisan bakery. Visitors choose a box on this site and send an Instagram message to place an order. There is no checkout cart. Pickup and delivery depend on the customer's area.

## Site

- Hebrew homepage: /
- English homepage: /en
- Order by Instagram DM: https://ig.me/m/cookiepinuki
- Instagram profile: https://www.instagram.com/cookiepinuki/

## Menu

- Boutique krembo box of 6 — 80 ILS (bestseller)
- Gluten-free boutique krembo box of 6 — 95 ILS
- Indulgent chocolate chip cookies box of 6 — 75 ILS
- Chocolate rugelach, small (~8) — 40 ILS or large (~16) — 80 ILS
- Snowy cookies box of 15 — 55 ILS
- Donuts box of 6 — 75 ILS

Every box is baked by hand after the order.

## Brand

Cookie Pinuki. Est. 2023. Theme color #3D1F0D.
